comments.author: nkrisc
comments.story: It’s hard to give a good intuitive explanation for the volume of a cone
comments.why: Great way to explain and visualize higher spatial dimensions
comments.text: I found this video explaining quaternions to actually be a great way to explain (and visualize) higher spatial dimensions: [VIDEO] When you think about the nth dimension as a projection of the n+1th dimension, it begins to make a lot more sense. That doesn’t mean you can necessarily visualize the 4th spatial dimension directly, but you can at least visualize how the 3rd dimension can be a projection of the 4th, just like how we can easily see that the 2nd dimension as a projection of the third.
